status: DRAFT - not frozen. Copy to PROTOCOL_v2.json, fill every TBD, write its SHA-256 to PROTOCOL_v2.sha256 and upload both to OSF before the first holdout2 run.
title: Confirmatory test of gain-aligned kick targeting on an untouched set (PROTOCOL_v2)
engine: unchanged fast_ils.py (2-opt + Or-opt, 10-NN candidates, don't-look bits, better-only acceptance)
machine: Intel Core i5-9300H (4C/8T), 16 GB, Windows 11 x64, Python 3.13; all compared strategies run in the same session, paired

strategies.knn_global: primary-campaign kNN rank proxy, pool rule TBD (tuned on development sets)
strategies.excess_global: training-free excess-length proxy, pool rule TBD (tuned on development sets)
strategies.cheap_global: membership-trained cheap MLP (models/cheap_scorer.npz), pool rule TBD
strategies.gain_global: gain-trained cheap MLP (models/cheap_gain_scorer.npz), pool rule TBD
strategies.online_global: TBD (online_targeting.py; parameters fixed on development sets)

pool_rule_tuning: each signal's (pool fraction, target probability) chosen on vlsi_old + synth_1000 only from the grid {0.02,0.04,0.06,0.10} x {0.5,0.75,0.9}; chosen values recorded here before freezing
metric: gap (%) to the reference at 10 s, mean over seeds within instance; instance is the unit of inference

hypotheses_fixed_sequence.note: fixed-sequence (hierarchical) testing at alpha = 0.05: each hypothesis is tested only if all previous ones were rejected; this controls the family-wise error rate without Holm splitting
hypotheses_fixed_sequence.H7: online_global vs best untrained proxy (knn_global or excess_global, whichever is better on the development sets - TBD): two-sided Wilcoxon; success = mean difference < 0 and p < 0.05
hypotheses_fixed_sequence.H8: pool composition: mean excess length of wrong pool edges, knn > cheap (paired Wilcoxon over instances, on 2 s random-ILS incumbents)
hypotheses_fixed_sequence.H6: gain_global vs knn_global: TOST with margin +-0.025 gap points

power_analysis: TBD from v2_analysis.py power on vlsi_primary_10s (gnn_global:knn_global); target 80% power at delta = 0.04 for H7
secondary: kicks per second, model share, stale cuts
exclusions: none; crashes and invalid tours are reported, not dropped
